messages.subject: RE: Vholes — tax treatment of the £30k
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel — first £30,000 of the ex gratia is paid free of tax and NICs under s.401 ITEPA; the £80,000 balance is taxed under PAYE (income tax but no employee NIC). The PILON of £107,500 and the £43,000 bonus are fully taxable as earnings. The PENP figure equals the PILON, so there's no additional charge there. It's all set out on the breakdown tab we sent the Board.

Sarah
